meaningTr: Şer gibi görünen hayır, gizli şans.
definitionEn: Something bad that turns out to be good.

examples.sentence: Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise; I met an old friend walking.
examples.translation: Otobüsü kaçırmak gizli bir şanstı; yürürken eski bir arkadaşımla karşılaştım.

definitionEn: Something very easy to do.

examples.sentence: The English test was a piece of cake.
examples.translation: İngilizce sınavı çok kolaydı.

definitionEn: A big fuss about something small.

examples.sentence: The argument was just a storm in a teacup.
examples.translation: Tartışma bir kaşık suda fırtınaydı.

meaningTr: Lafla peynir gemisi yürümez; davranış sözden güçlüdür.
definitionEn: What you do is more important than what you say.

examples.sentence: Don't promise; just study. Actions speak louder than words.
examples.translation: Söz verme; sadece çalış. Davranış sözden güçlüdür.

meaningTr: Tuz biber ekmek, yaraya tuz basmak.
definitionEn: To make a bad situation even worse.

examples.sentence: Losing the match was bad; the rain added insult to injury.
examples.translation: Maçı kaybetmek kötüydü; yağmur da tuzu biberi oldu.

meaningTr: Dört kulakla dinlemek, pür dikkat kesilmek.
definitionEn: Listening very carefully.

examples.sentence: Tell me everything; I'm all ears.
examples.translation: Her şeyi anlat; dört kulakla dinliyorum.

definitionEn: Someone you love very much.

examples.sentence: Her little brother is the apple of her eye.
examples.translation: Küçük kardeşi onun göz bebeği.

definitionEn: Having to start again from the beginning after a failure.

examples.sentence: Our plan failed, so we are back to square one.
examples.translation: Planımız başarısız oldu, yani başa döndük.

meaningTr: Yanlış kişiden şüphelenmek, yanlış iz sürmek.
definitionEn: Blaming the wrong person or following a wrong idea.

examples.sentence: If you think I broke the window, you are barking up the wrong tree.
examples.translation: Pencereyi benim kırdığımı düşünüyorsan yanlış kişiden şüpheleniyorsun.

definitionEn: Avoiding the main point in a conversation.

examples.sentence: Stop beating around the bush and tell me the truth.
examples.translation: Lafı dolandırmayı bırak ve gerçeği söyle.

definitionEn: It is better to do something late than not at all.

examples.sentence: You finally started running? Better late than never!
examples.translation: Sonunda koşmaya mı başladın? Geç olsun güç olmasın!

expression: Bite off more than you can chew
definitionEn: To take on more work than you can handle.

examples.sentence: Three projects at once? Don't bite off more than you can chew.
examples.translation: Aynı anda üç proje mi? Boyundan büyük işe kalkışma.

definitionEn: A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.

examples.sentence: You have a concert tonight? Break a leg!
examples.translation: Bu akşam konserin mi var? Bol şans!

definitionEn: To make people feel more comfortable and encourage conversation in a social situation.

examples.sentence: He told a funny story to break the ice.
examples.translation: Ortamı yumuşatmak için komik bir hikâye anlattı.

meaningTr: Gece geç saatlere kadar ders çalışmak.
definitionEn: To study or work late into the night.

examples.sentence: Exams are near; she's burning the midnight oil.
examples.translation: Sınavlar yakın; gece geç saatlere kadar çalışıyor.

definitionEn: Feeling nervous and excited before something important.

examples.sentence: I had butterflies in my stomach before the presentation.
examples.translation: Sunumdan önce karnımda kelebekler uçuşuyordu.

definitionEn: Doing everything according to the rules.

examples.sentence: Our teacher does everything by the book.
examples.translation: Öğretmenimiz her şeyi kuralına göre yapar.

definitionEn: To stop working for the rest of the day.

examples.sentence: We finished half of the project, so let's call it a day.
examples.translation: Projenin yarısını bitirdik, o yüzden bugünlük bırakalım.

expression: Cost an arm and a leg
definitionEn: To be very expensive.

examples.sentence: The new phone costs an arm and a leg.
examples.translation: Yeni telefon çok pahalı.

expression: Cross that bridge when you come to it
definitionEn: Deal with a problem only when it happens.

examples.sentence: Don't worry about university now; cross that bridge later.
examples.translation: Üniversiteyi şimdi dert etme; günü gelince düşünürsün.

definitionEn: Worrying about something you cannot change.

examples.sentence: The exam is over; no use crying over spilled milk.
examples.translation: Sınav bitti; olmuşla ölmüşe çare yok.

definitionEn: To do something cheaply or quickly, usually badly.

examples.sentence: Don't cut corners while studying; learn everything well.
examples.translation: Çalışırken işten kaçma; her şeyi iyi öğren.

definitionEn: Go directly to the main point.

examples.sentence: We have little time, so cut to the chase.
examples.translation: Az vaktimiz var, sadede gel.

expression: Don't count your chickens before they hatch
definitionEn: Don't assume success before it happens.

examples.sentence: You haven't passed yet; don't count your chickens.
examples.translation: Henüz geçmedin; dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvama.

expression: Don't put all your eggs in one basket
definitionEn: Don't risk everything on one plan.

examples.sentence: Apply to two schools; don't put all eggs in one basket.
examples.translation: İki okula başvur; bütün yumurtaları aynı sepete koyma.

meaningTr: Morali bozuk olmak, kafası bozuk olmak.
definitionEn: Feeling sad and without energy.

examples.sentence: She's been down in the dumps since the match.
examples.translation: Maçtan beri morali bozuk.

definitionEn: Practical and realistic; not arrogant.

examples.sentence: Despite her fame, she is very down to earth.
examples.translation: Şöhretine rağmen çok mütevazı.

meaningTr: Sınır çizmek, bir noktada dur demek.
definitionEn: To set a limit you will not cross.

examples.sentence: Jokes are fine, but I draw the line at insults.
examples.translation: Şakalar tamam ama hakarette sınırı çizerim.

definitionEn: Do something slowly and carefully.

examples.sentence: Easy does it with that heavy box!
examples.translation: O ağır kutuyla yavaş ol!

definitionEn: To admit you were wrong.

examples.sentence: He was wrong, so he ate humble pie.
examples.translation: Haksızdı, o yüzden hatasını kabul etti.

expression: Every cloud has a silver lining
definitionEn: Good can come from bad situations.

examples.sentence: Rain ruined the picnic, but every cloud has a silver lining — we played games at home.
examples.translation: Yağmur pikniği bozdu ama her şerde bir hayır var — evde oyun oynadık.

definitionEn: To accept criticism or punishment for something you did.

examples.sentence: He broke the window, so now he must face the music.
examples.translation: Pencereyi kırdı, şimdi sonuçlarla yüzleşmeli.

meaningTr: Turp gibi olmak, çok sağlıklı olmak.
definitionEn: Very healthy and strong.

examples.sentence: My grandpa is fit as a fiddle at eighty.
examples.translation: Dedem sekseninde turp gibi.

definitionEn: To be extremely angry.

examples.sentence: The coach was foaming at the mouth after the defeat.
examples.translation: Antrenör yenilgiden sonra küplere bindi.

definitionEn: To suddenly become afraid of doing something you planned.

examples.sentence: She got cold feet before her speech.
examples.translation: Konuşmasından önce son anda korktu.

definitionEn: To become uncontrolled.

examples.sentence: The party got out of hand.
examples.translation: Parti kontrolden çıktı.

definitionEn: To organize yourself and behave well.

examples.sentence: Exams start Monday; get your act together!
examples.translation: Sınavlar pazartesi başlıyor; toparlan!

expression: Give someone the benefit of the doubt
meaningTr: İyi niyetle yaklaşmak, şüpheyi sanık lehine yorumlamak.
definitionEn: To trust someone even when unsure.

examples.sentence: He's late, but give him the benefit of the doubt.
examples.translation: Geç kaldı ama iyi niyetle yaklaş.

definitionEn: To ignore someone deliberately.

examples.sentence: After the argument, he gave me the cold shoulder.
examples.translation: Tartışmadan sonra bana soğuk davrandı.

definitionEn: To become very excited or crazy.

examples.sentence: Fans went bananas when the team scored.
examples.translation: Takım gol atınca taraftarlar çıldırdı.

definitionEn: To fail spectacularly.

examples.sentence: Our plan went down in flames.
examples.translation: Planımız büyük bir başarısızlıkla sonuçlandı.

definitionEn: To do more than what is expected.

examples.sentence: She went the extra mile to help her classmates.
examples.translation: Sınıf arkadaşlarına yardım etmek için fazladan çaba gösterdi.

definitionEn: Don't give up during hard times.

examples.sentence: Exam week is hard, but hang in there!
examples.translation: Sınav haftası zor ama dayan!

definitionEn: Deeply in love.

examples.sentence: They fell head over heels in high school.
examples.translation: Lisede sırılsıklam âşık oldular.

definitionEn: To start studying hard.

examples.sentence: Exams are next week, so I must hit the books.
examples.translation: Sınavlar haftaya, o yüzden ders çalışmaya koyulmalıyım.

expression: Hit the nail on the head
meaningTr: Tam isabet ettirmek, tam doğruyu söylemek.
definitionEn: To say exactly the right thing.

examples.sentence: You hit the nail on the head with that answer.
examples.translation: Bu cevapla tam isabet ettirdin.

definitionEn: To start a journey.

examples.sentence: It's getting late; let's hit the road.
examples.translation: Geç oluyor; yola koyulalım.

definitionEn: To go to bed.

examples.sentence: I'm exhausted; I'll hit the sack.
examples.translation: Bitkinim; yatağa gidiyorum.

definitionEn: To explain briefly.

examples.sentence: In a nutshell, the film is about friendship.
examples.translation: Kısacası film dostluk hakkında.

definitionEn: In trouble because of something you did.

examples.sentence: He forgot his homework and now he is in hot water.
examples.translation: Ödevini unuttu ve şimdi başı dertte.

definitionEn: Sharing the same difficult situation.

examples.sentence: We both failed math; we're in the same boat.
examples.translation: İkimiz de matematikten kaldık; aynı durumdayız.

definitionEn: A strong wish to travel.

examples.sentence: Spring gives me itchy feet.
examples.translation: Bahar gelince içimde gezme isteği uyanıyor.

definitionEn: To join something because it is popular.

examples.sentence: Many students jumped on the bandwagon and started a podcast.
examples.translation: Birçok öğrenci modaya uyup podcast başlattı.

definitionEn: To decide too quickly without facts.

examples.sentence: Don't jump to conclusions; listen first.
examples.translation: Peşin hüküm verme; önce dinle.

definitionEn: To watch something carefully.

examples.sentence: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
examples.translation: Çantama göz kulak olabilir misin?

definitionEn: To hope for good luck.

examples.sentence: Keep your fingers crossed for my exam!
examples.translation: Sınavım için şans dile!

expression: Kill two birds with one stone
definitionEn: Achieve two things with one action.

examples.sentence: Cycling to school kills two birds: sport and transport.
examples.translation: Okula bisikletle gitmek bir taşla iki kuş: spor ve ulaşım.

definitionEn: To learn how to do a job.

examples.sentence: The new student is still learning the ropes.
examples.translation: Yeni öğrenci hâlâ ortama alışmaya çalışıyor.

definitionEn: Don't restart old arguments.

examples.sentence: Don't mention last year's fight; let sleeping dogs lie.
examples.translation: Geçen yılki kavgayı açma; eski defterleri karıştırma.

expression: Let the cat out of the bag
definitionEn: To reveal a secret by mistake.

examples.sentence: He let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
examples.translation: Sürpriz partiyle ilgili sırrı ağzından kaçırdı.

expression: Light at the end of the tunnel
definitionEn: Hope after a hard period.

examples.sentence: Finals end Friday; there's light at the end of the tunnel!
examples.translation: Finaller cuma bitiyor; tünelin ucunda ışık var!

definitionEn: To tell something briefly.

examples.sentence: To make a long story short, we missed the bus.
examples.translation: Uzun lafın kısası, otobüsü kaçırdık.

definitionEn: To miss an opportunity.

examples.sentence: Apply now or you will miss the boat.
examples.translation: Hemen başvur, yoksa fırsatı kaçırırsın.

definitionEn: You must work hard to succeed.

examples.sentence: Daily practice is boring, but no pain, no gain.
examples.translation: Her gün pratik sıkıcı ama emeksiz yemek olmaz.

expression: Not playing with a full deck
definitionEn: Joking way to say someone is a bit foolish.

examples.sentence: He tried to dry his phone in the microwave — not playing with a full deck!
examples.translation: Telefonunu mikrodalgada kurutmaya çalıştı — tahtası eksik!

definitionEn: Free from trouble; slang for amazing.

examples.sentence: The concert last night was off the hook!
examples.translation: Dün geceki konser müthişti!

meaningTr: Çok mutlu olmak, sevinçten havalara uçmak.
definitionEn: Extremely happy.

examples.sentence: She was on cloud nine after getting the scholarship.
examples.translation: Bursu kazandıktan sonra çok mutluydu.

meaningTr: İnce buz üstünde yürümek, riskli durumda olmak.
definitionEn: In a risky situation.

examples.sentence: After three warnings, he's on thin ice.
examples.translation: Üç uyarıdan sonra ince buzda yürüyor.

definitionEn: Very rarely.

examples.sentence: We eat fast food once in a blue moon.
examples.translation: Çok nadiren fast food yeriz.

definitionEn: Suddenly and unexpectedly.

examples.sentence: Out of the blue, an old friend called me.
examples.translation: Hiç beklenmedik bir anda eski bir arkadaşım aradı.

meaningTr: Yoktan var etmek, birdenbire ortaya çıkmak.
definitionEn: Appearing suddenly from nothing.

examples.sentence: An old friend appeared out of thin air.
examples.translation: Eski bir arkadaş birdenbire ortaya çıktı.

definitionEn: Very happy and excited about something.

examples.sentence: He was over the moon about his exam results.
examples.translation: Sınav sonuçları için çok sevinçliydi.

definitionEn: Decide what to do as things happen.

examples.sentence: No fixed plan; we'll play it by ear.
examples.translation: Sabit plan yok; duruma göre bakacağız.

definitionEn: Doing something often makes you good at it.

examples.sentence: Read aloud daily; practice makes perfect.
examples.translation: Her gün sesli oku; tekrar mükemmelleştirir.

definitionEn: To joke with someone in a friendly way.

examples.sentence: Don't worry, I was just pulling your leg.
examples.translation: Merak etme, sadece şaka yapıyordum.

definitionEn: Calm down and behave normally.

examples.sentence: Pull yourself together; the exam starts in five minutes.
examples.translation: Kendine gel; sınav beş dakika sonra başlıyor.

definitionEn: To rain very heavily.

examples.sentence: Take an umbrella; it is raining cats and dogs.
examples.translation: Şemsiye al; bardaktan boşanırcasına yağmur yağıyor.

definitionEn: To spoil someone's joy.

examples.sentence: I hate to rain on your parade, but the trip is cancelled.
examples.translation: Hevesini kırmak istemem ama gezi iptal.

definitionEn: Understand hidden meanings.

examples.sentence: Her smile said yes, but read between the lines — she was sad.
examples.translation: Gülümsemesi evet diyordu ama satır arasını oku — üzgündü.

definitionEn: Saved from trouble by an interruption.

examples.sentence: The teacher was about to ask me, but I was saved by the bell.
examples.translation: Öğretmen bana soracaktı ama zil beni kurtardı.

meaningTr: İkinci doğa gibi olmak, alışkanlık hâline gelmek.
definitionEn: Something you do automatically.

examples.sentence: After a month, locking the door became second nature.
examples.translation: Bir ay sonra kapıyı kilitlemek alışkanlık oldu.

definitionEn: To agree with someone on something.

examples.sentence: We don't always see eye to eye, but we are good friends.
examples.translation: Her zaman aynı fikirde değiliz ama iyi arkadaşız.

definitionEn: Avoiding making a decision.

examples.sentence: You can't sit on the fence forever; choose a team.
examples.translation: Sonsuza kadar kararsız kalamazsın; bir takım seç.

definitionEn: Wait patiently without moving.

examples.sentence: Sit tight; the bus is coming.
examples.translation: Kıpırdama; otobüs geliyor.

definitionEn: Said when a person you were just talking about appears.

examples.sentence: Speak of the devil! We were just talking about you.
examples.translation: İyi insan lafının üstüne gelirmiş! Tam da senden bahsediyorduk.

definitionEn: To reveal a secret.

examples.sentence: Come on, spill the beans! What happened?
examples.translation: Hadi, anlat! Ne oldu?

definitionEn: Take attention away from someone.

examples.sentence: Announcing your news at her party stole her thunder.
examples.translation: Haberini onun partisinde açıklamak rol çaldı.

definitionEn: To refuse an invitation now but ask to do it later.

examples.sentence: I can't come today, but can I take a rain check?
examples.translation: Bugün gelemem ama başka bir zamana ertelesek olur mu?

expression: The ball is in your court
definitionEn: It is your turn to take action.

examples.sentence: I sent the invitation; now the ball is in your court.
examples.translation: Davetiyeyi gönderdim; şimdi sıra sende.

expression: The devil is in the details
definitionEn: Small details can cause big problems.

examples.sentence: Check your essay twice; the devil is in the details.
examples.translation: Kompozisyonunu iki kez kontrol et; şeytan ayrıntıda gizlidir.

expression: The grass is always greener on the other side
definitionEn: Others' lives always look better than yours.

examples.sentence: Don't envy that school; the grass is always greener.
examples.translation: O okulu kıskanma; komşunun tavuğu kaz görünür.

definitionEn: The final problem that makes you give up.

examples.sentence: Forgetting my birthday was the last straw.
examples.translation: Doğum günümü unutması bardağı taşıran son damlaydı.

definitionEn: Supporting someone in good times and bad times.

examples.sentence: True friends stay together through thick and thin.
examples.translation: Gerçek arkadaşlar iyi günde kötü günde birlikte kalır.

meaningTr: Kendini iyi hissetmemek, hafif hasta olmak.
definitionEn: Feeling slightly sick or unwell.

examples.sentence: She stayed home because she felt under the weather.
examples.translation: Kendini iyi hissetmediği için evde kaldı.

meaningTr: Asla olmayacak bir şey (balık kavağa çıkınca).
definitionEn: Something that will never happen.

examples.sentence: He will clean his room when pigs fly.
examples.translation: Odasını balık kavağa çıkınca temizler.
